message.content:
'To Kill a Mockingbird' by Harper Lee is widely available at many online bookstores. Some of the major online bookstores that typically carry this classic novel include:

- Amazon
- Barnes & Noble
- Book Depository
- AbeBooks
- ThriftBooks
- IndieBound
- Powell's Books

Please note that availability can vary by location and time, so it's always a good idea to check the specific bookstore's website to confirm current stock before purchasing.
